display.purpose: Page titles; RTL uses inherited sans-serif.

components.name: Page tree
components.description: Nested page-tree navigation with a current-page state.
components.html: HomeNotes
components.css: .ds-tree{font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","Noto Sans Arabic",Arial,sans-serif;background:var(--sidebar,#f5f4ef)}.ds-tree a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:7px 10px;margin-block:3px;color:var(--muted,#696c62);font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;text-decoration:none;border-radius:4px}.ds-tree a:hover,.ds-tree a[aria-current]{background:var(--selected,#e8ece2);color:var(--ink,#282b25)}.ds-tree a[aria-current]{font-weight:600}.ds-tree a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#54713c);outline-offset:4px;border-radius:2px;}@media(max-width:800px){.ds-tree a{min-height:40px}}

components.name: Search
components.description: Borderless page search with a visible shortcut hint.
components.html: /
components.css: .ds-search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;min-height:36px;color:var(--muted,#696c62);font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","Noto Sans Arabic",Arial,sans-serif}.ds-search label{display:flex}.ds-search input{flex:1;min-width:0;background:transparent;border:0;color:var(--ink,#282b25);font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","Noto Sans Arabic",Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;padding:7px 3px;caret-color:var(--accent,#3e6244)}.ds-search input::placeholder{color:var(--muted,#696c62);opacity:1}.ds-search input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#54713c);outline-offset:4px;border-radius:2px;}.ds-search kbd{font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","Noto Sans Arabic",Arial,sans-serif;font-size:11px;line-height:1.3;border:1px solid var(--line,#e2e3da);border-radius:3px;padding:1px 5px}

components.css: .ds-disclosure{font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","Noto Sans Arabic",Arial,sans-serif;font-size:16px;line-height:1.85;color:var(--ink,#282b25);border-block:1px solid var(--line,#e2e3da);padding:14px 20px;margin-block:26px}.ds-disclosure summary{cursor:pointer;list-style-position:outside;font-size:14px;font-weight:500}.ds-disclosure[open] summary{margin-block-end:15px}.ds-disclosure p{margin:0 0 2px}.ds-disclosure summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#54713c);outline-offset:4px;border-radius:2px;}

components.css: .ds-children{font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","Noto Sans Arabic",Arial,sans-serif;line-height:1.7;border-block-start:1px solid var(--line,#e2e3da)}.ds-children a{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px;padding:17px 0;border-block-end:1px solid var(--line,#e2e3da);color:var(--accent,#3e6244);text-decoration:none}.ds-children strong{font-size:15px;font-weight:500;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:.22em}.ds-children small{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted,#696c62);margin-block-start:4px}.ds-children a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#54713c);outline-offset:4px;border-radius:2px;}.ds-children:dir(rtl) svg{transform:scaleX(-1)}

narrative.overview: A quiet, text-first personal notebook uses paper surfaces, linked prose, and a page tree. Native fonts and controls keep it portable; modest hierarchy and thin separators help readers find their place. The user approved this restrained visual direction and native serif titles.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and restrained green links.
A readable document column beside nested navigation.
Native disclosures, visible focus, and mirrored reading direction.
Light, dark, and system appearance without authored animation.

rules.name: The Reading Direction Rule
rules.body: Use logical spacing and borders; isolate inline code left-to-right with `direction: ltr` and `unicode-bidi: isolate` inside RTL prose.

dos: Do preserve native fonts, controls, and semantic navigation.
Do keep reading text within the established column and let code and tables scroll locally.
Do use logical spacing and isolate inline code in RTL content.
Do carry the complete palette roles through light, dark, and system appearance.
donts: Don't require JavaScript for reading or ordinary page navigation.
Don't add unnecessary decoration or motion to this plain notebook.
Don't substitute fixed physical directions for mirrored navigation and prose spacing.
